documents.title: Main Entry Point
documents.description: Boots DB, seeds on first run, starts the scheduler, serves the FastAPI API (8505) on a thread and the Gradio UI (7845) on the main thread.

documents.title: FastAPI App
documents.description: REST endpoints: QI contract (/health,/version,/info), /stats, /regions, /sources, /listings(+/{id}), /profiles CRUD + /matches, /ingest, /notifications, /digest. CORS from qi_registry.

documents.title: Static Config
documents.description: App name/version, server ports + host, logging level/dir. Runtime settings live in the DB settings table.

documents.title: Ingestion Pipeline
documents.description: ingest / refresh / pull_for_profile / clear_listings; raw capture, normalize, translate, cross-source dedup, upsert, match-on-ingest.

documents.title: DB Layer + Schema
documents.description: WAL connection helper, init_db with additive migrations, seeds 47 prefectures + 7 sources + default settings. Bilingual region-driven schema.

documents.title: Normalizer
documents.description: raw -> uniform listing fields; derives era / seismic class / bedrooms / renovation estimate and the cross-source dedup_key.

documents.title: Translation Engine
documents.description: Cached JA->EN with DeepL -> Ollama -> offline glossary fallback chain; never discards the Japanese original.

documents.title: Matching Engine
documents.description: match() (AND of specified constraints + 0..1 relevance score), match_for_listings (on ingest), rematch_profile (on profile edit).

documents.title: Profiles / Notify / Scheduler / Queries
documents.description: Profile CRUD + cadence; digest builder + SMTP email; APScheduler ingest/daily/per-profile jobs; dynamic listing search + stats.

documents.title: Geocoding / Enrichment / Map
documents.description: Nominatim municipality geocoder (cached); detail-page enrichment (photos/specs/station/days-on-market); folium Japan choropleth + clustered pins + hazard overlays.

documents.title: Adapter Base + Registry
documents.description: BaseAdapter (fixtures-vs-live, polite rate-limited _get); registry mapping 7 source keys to adapter instances.

documents.title: at-home Akiya Bank scraper
documents.description: Live scraper for the MLIT-sanctioned at-home national akiya-bank portal: JIS-code per-prefecture URLs, section.propety list parsing, detail-page photo/spec extraction. 926 listings.

documents.title: SUUMO scraper
documents.description: Live scraper for SUUMO used detached houses: prefecture + city result pages, div.property_unit parsing. 939 listings.

documents.title: Portal adapter classes
documents.description: LIFULL / at-home / HOME'S / Rakumachi / Municipal-Nagano adapters (fixture-only, documented selectors) + the working at-home-akiya & SUUMO fetch_live implementations and profile-target-prefecture resolution.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (akiyascout)
documents.description: Registry entry: ports api 8505 / ui 7845, family_tier 'cousin', status active_development, exposed endpoints, single-user LOCAL-only notes.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Map
documents.description: Full port table, family map, and integration contracts for the whole QI ecosystem.

documents.title: QI Standards / Architecture Principles
documents.description: Naming/folder/code conventions and the Six Laws AkiyaScout is built to comply with.

documents.title: QI Service Registry
documents.description: Canonical NSSM service registry. No QI_AkiyaScout service is registered yet — AkiyaScout currently runs via Start_AkiyaScout.bat (service registration is a planned item).
